_note: Affinities a prime vestige can carry (design/01: a prime delivers a talent and 1+ affinities; more affinities is rarer and worth more). Brent 2026-10-11 approved: fire, earth, wind and lightning beside water; affinities are fixed per prime (a talent's 'affinities' list in talents.json, else prime_default); most primes carry one, a couple carry two. 'kit' is the three abilities a character with that affinity starts with: a ranged attack, a melee strike, a movement skill. Labels, descriptions and kits are ours [MODEL].

water.label: Water
water.desc: Pressure, flow and weight. Strikes that hit like a wave and movement that slips past a guard.

fire.label: Fire
fire.desc: Quick, cheap and hungry. It asks little essence and takes the rest out of you.

earth.label: Earth
earth.desc: Slow, heavy and sure. Nothing arrives fast, and nothing it hits stays standing.

wind.label: Wind
wind.desc: Light and far-reaching. Small costs, long reach, and you are never where you were.

lightning.label: Lightning
lightning.desc: All at once or not at all. Short, violent and expensive.
